label: Residence required before a foreign dependant is covered
appliesTo: Foreign nationals and overseas Koreans who entered Korea on or after 3 April 2024, seeking dependant status on an employee's health insurance
why: It decides whether a family member arriving with you is covered from day one or after half a year, which for a family relocation is one of the larger unbudgeted costs. Spouses, minor children and several named residence statuses are exempt from the wait.

history.note: Applies to entries on or after this date. Immediate exceptions: a spouse and minor children, plus study (D-2), general training for primary and secondary students (D-4-3), non-professional employment (E-9), permanent residence (F-5), marriage migration (F-6) and residence-purpose status.
